description: Search ACLED political-violence and protest events. Filter by country (use "|" to OR, e.g., "Ukraine|Russia"), region, event_type, actor, ISO country code, or date range. Returns date, lat/lon, actors, event type, fatalities, and source notes.

actor.description: Match actor1 or actor2 (partial substring ok)

event_type.description: Battles | Protests | Riots | Explosions/Remote violence | Violence against civilians | Strategic developments

iso.description: ISO 3166-1 numeric country code (alternative to country)

limit.description: Records to return (1-5000, default 100; ACLED max-per-call is 5000)

name: search_events
